source_policy.official_selection_rule: Only an official archive with a documented license, URL and archive hash may enter the reliable set; selected file hashes are recorded after extraction.

midi_render_policy.tail_rule: ceil((last source note end + fixed tail) * sample_rate) frames
midi_render_policy.source_event_check: FluidSynth event dump note-on/off pitch and velocity multisets must match source MIDI; two trimmed outputs must be byte-identical

source_policy.local_midi_cases: synthetic generated/special + official MAESTRO clips; CCMusic and PJS audio are not rendered by this policy

pjs-v1.1.selection_rule: pjs001-pjs005 selected by stable corpus directory name; each retains source WAV/MIDI/MusicXML/lab together

ccmusic-demo.license: free for computational musicology; no SPDX license identifier declared by the record
ccmusic-demo.selection_rule: official demo archive hash verified; one Yueding Chinese mixed-song recording split into five 16-quarter/12-second bar-aligned segments; each retains aligned mixture WAV, cropped vocal-score MIDI, and exact MusicXML-derived beat grid
ccmusic-demo.notes: Derived audio and MIDI remain in .cache and are never committed. The five segments are correlated slices of one research recording, not five independent songs.

maestro-v3-midi.archive_size_note: 官方页约56 MB；下载后记录实际字节数
maestro-v3-midi.selection_rule: after archive hash verification, record ten distinct piano MIDI archive members in sorted member order; direct FluidSynth renders and clip manifests are hash-verified before registry update

generated.renderer_policy: all 15 generated/special MIDI-domain production inputs use the single pinned direct FluidSynth policy in source_policy.midi_render_policy
